{{Quote|His airspeeder was blown up at an open-air market on Coruscant. A market where, at about the same time, two mercenaries&mdash;and suspected assassins&mdash;were found dead. Face's body wasn't found, but security detected genetic material, confirmed as his, in the wreckage. His wife and daughter are just missing. No trace. He hasn’t responded to messages sent to any of the back routes I know. Jezzie's folks and other friends of the family can't reach him.|Myri Antilles|<ref name="MK" />}}
The '''attempted assassination of Garik Loran''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="MK" /> in [[44 ABY]].<ref name="TERC" /> As Garik Loran left the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Navy Command Complex|Navy Command Complex]] in his black [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]], he was tailed by three [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]: a [[Unidentified Human assassin (Garik Loran)|Human]], a [[Unidentified Sullustan assassin|Sullustan]], and an [[Unidentified Aqualish assassin|Aqualish]]. Realizing he was being followed, Loran led them into a crowded [[Unidentified Coruscant pedestrian market|pedestrian market]], where he lost sight of the Human while the Aqualish and Sullustan pursued him on foot. Loran [[Death/Legends|killed]] both pursuers with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] before returning to his airspeeder. As the vehicle rose three meters to the air, it exploded due to the explosive package that had been planted aboard while the other two assassins served as a distraction.<ref name="MK" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|The third killer went to my quarters. Broke in as slickly as I broke in here and confronted my wife in our bedroom, where she was packing to leave. She shot him, a twin burn to the gut. He took a while to die. She said he kept murmuring.|Garik Loran|<ref name="MK" />}}
The Human assassin then went to Loran's [[Garik Loran's apartment|apartment]], where [[Dia Passik]], Loran's [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], and their adopted daughter, [[Adra Passik]], were staying. Intending to kill them as well, he broke into the apartment after Loran, who had survived the explosion, secretly warned Dia via [[Comlink/Legends|commlink]]. The assassin confronted Dia while she was packing to leave, but she shot him twice in the abdomen, leaving him mortally wounded.<ref name="MK" />

Loran would later confront [[Director of Galactic Alliance Intelligence|Director]] of [[Galactic Alliance Intelligence Service|Galactic Alliance Intelligence]] [[Borath Maddeus]] in his role in the [[Lecersen Conspiracy]] and the assassination attempt on his life.<ref name="MK" />
